evidence: Task-to-activity-centroid cosine similarity and blinded 1-5 human coherence ratings.
result: Activity median similarity 0.538-0.911; weighted mean 0.581. Validator means 3.833 and 4.056; median 4 for both.
interpretation: Tasks grouped under an activity have interpretable semantic concentration.
limit: Partition uniqueness remains unresolved by this descriptive similarity check.

evidence: KMeans at k=40 compared with HDBSCAN non-noise assignments.
result: Adjusted Rand index 0.460; normalized mutual information 0.822.
interpretation: A related broad organization appears under a different algorithm.
limit: Seed sensitivity remains unmeasured; k=40 also represents a different granularity.

evidence: Frozen activity vocabulary applied to ESCO v1.1.1 skills with a nearest-neighbor permutation baseline.
result: 5,730/5,826 scoped skills mapped; all 18 activities receive assignments; 3,893 high-confidence. Nearest-neighbor same-activity agreement 45.15% versus 8.52% after label permutation.
interpretation: The vocabulary remains usable on ESCO and assigned labels show non-random local structure in ESCO embedding space.
limit: Task-classification accuracy and item-level mapping correctness remain unmeasured.

evidence: Two independent validators review 18 blinded task cards in randomized order using open labels, coherence ratings, and outlier marking.
result: Exact coherence agreement 12/18; within one point 18/18; quadratic-weighted kappa 0.802. Strict direct recovery 15/18 and 16/18; direct-or-partial recovery 17/18 for each; three joint outliers among 71 examples.
interpretation: Most activities can be independently recognized without seeing the definitions.
limit: Two validators, manually selected cards, author-coded correspondence, and partial corpus annotation.

evidence: Stage-2 matching after definitions are revealed.
interpretation: Definitions are legible and distinguishable after exposure.
limit: Definition-legibility check only; procedure-execution remained the weakest open-label abstraction.
